text:
mica: Quick share — Queenie just got promoted to Senior ML Engineer!! Huge congrats!!! :tada: :trophy:
zara: NO WAY!!! so proud. big virtual hug 
queenie: omg thank you everyone 62d honestly surprised and grateful 
sam: congrats!! i'm remote that day but can absolutely do a 30s shout video and send a gift card :gift:
elena: would love to do something Friday. two ideas: midday cupcakes + 5-min shout or after-work drinks?
mica: yeah thinking short + sweet. open poll: react with :cupcake: for desk lunch or :beer: for after-hours drinks.
people-ops-bot: Promo logged. Swag tier unlocked and $150 celebratory budget allocated. I9ll DM the manager for logistics.
zara: :cupcake: from me. daytime is easier. also can we ensure dairy-free option?
sam: :cupcake: and sending a GIF (link) since i'll be remote. i'll also record a quick shout.
elena: :beer: if later works for others. but donate to charity instead of swag? open to that too.
mica: good call. @people-ops-bot can the budget accommodate a small donation to a nonprofit in lieu of party favors?
people-ops-bot: Yes. Budget can be split between treats and a donation. Please add the nonprofit and amount to the event notes.
remote-bot: Poll created: "Queenie promo celebration" — react :cupcake: or :beer:. Poll closes in 18 hours. Zoom link attached for remote attendees.
zara: vote + idea: cupcakes + $50 donation to Girls Who Code?
sam: happy to match up to $100 for the donation.
queenie: you all are making me tear up. donation is lovely but please keep it small — and definitely dairy-free cupcakes if possible (i'm allergic to cashews).
mica: noted on allergies. i'll order nut-free, dairy-free options and a small vanilla tray. i'll also set up a card to sign.
elena: i'll grab a playlist and bring a small savory platter too.
people-ops-bot: Physical card request submitted. Swag order placed (t-shirt + sticker pack) but can be reallocated to donation per organizer note.
remote-bot: Calendar: "Queenie Senior Promo — Mini Cheer" Fri 12:30-12:45 Kitchen Island + Zoom. Invite sent to channel.
sam: DMing my 30s shout and the gift card link now. glad we can include remote peeps.
queenie: thanks again everyone, honestly means so much. see you Friday (or on Zoom) :sparkles:
zara (reaction): :tada: (added by zara)
elena (reaction): :heart: (added by elena)
